input.answer: Food cost 2.2% more in September 2026 than in September 2025. I read "groceries and other food" as the CPI "Food" aggregate for Canada, which covers food from stores and from restaurants. The CPI index (2002=100) was 201.8 in 2026-09 and 197.5 in 2025-09. The change is (201.8 − 197.5) / 197.5 = 4.3 / 197.5 = 2.18%, which rounds to 2.2%. I did not report "Food purchased from stores" on its own. My query for that series returned an error.
